install.windows: Use the official PowerShell or CMD installer linked at https://antigravity.google/download. The native command is agy and the default executable is %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe.
install.macos_linux: Use the official install.sh linked at https://antigravity.google/download. The default executable is ~/.local/bin/agy.

agent_steps: Detect the OS and architecture, then check for the official agy executable.
Use only the matching Antigravity CLI installer from the official download page; Antigravity 2.0 and Antigravity IDE are separate downloads.
After installation verify agy --version and the executable path. The user signs into a Google account in the native CLI.

identity_guard.description: Antigravity CLI is the official terminal client named agy. It is separate from Antigravity 2.0 Desktop and Antigravity IDE. EchoBird manages Google account selection; it does not configure Gemini API keys.
